QuestInfo.name: [Partem Ruins] Surprising Identity
QuestInfo.0: You've arrived at Mortargrind Hill. See what Morin has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Report the true identity of the Dark Magicians to Neinheart at Mortargrind Hill.
QuestInfo.2: The Dark Magician turned out to be none other than the missing triplets. You told Neinheart about it and he asked you look into the reports of the Ancient Monster as well.
